description: This source file contains functions and event handling code related to dynamic navigation menus, including toggling sub-menus, managing heights for transitions, and initializing event listeners for navigation items.

methods.name: resetHeightAfterAnimation(item)
methods.description: Sets the height of a menu element to 'auto' after a transition to allow for dynamic menu expansion.

methods.name: findNavItem(start)
methods.description: Traverses DOM ancestors to find and return the closest element with class 'Nav__item'.

methods.name: toggleSubMenu(ev)
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of a submenu by changing height and class, handling both user interactions and initial load conditions.
